# CLI reference

## `memini version`

Print version information

```text
Print version information

Usage: version
```

## `memini doctor`

Diagnose namespace mismatches and store health

```text
Diagnose namespace mismatches and store health

Usage: doctor [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --fix    Remediate diagnosed problems (preview unless --yes)
      --scrub  Remove content junk and exact duplicates (preview unless --yes)
      --yes    Apply changes instead of previewing them
  -h, --help   Print help
```

## `memini export`

Export memories to memini's portable, re-importable JSON format

```text
Export memories to memini's portable, re-importable JSON format

Usage: export [OPTIONS] [FILE]

Arguments:
  [FILE]  Output path; omit to write stdout

Options:
      --namespace <NAMESPACE>  Namespace to export (defaults to the resolved default)
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>        Output path; omit to write stdout
      --all-namespaces         Export every namespace
      --include-expired        Include memories past their TTL
      --include-superseded     Include contradiction-tombstoned memories
      --pretty                 Indent the JSON output
      --tier <TIER>            Restrict to these tiers (repeatable)
      --tag <TAG>              Require this exact tag (repeatable, AND)
      --meta <METADATA>        Require metadata key=value (repeatable, AND)
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## `memini import`

Bulk-load an export from another memory system

```text
Bulk-load an export from another memory system

Usage: import [OPTIONS] [FILE]

Arguments:
  [FILE]  Input path; omit or use - to read stdin

Options:
      --source <SOURCE>
          Export format: agentmemory, claude-code, mem0, memini, or mnemory [default: memini]
      --namespace <NAMESPACE>
          Fallback namespace for records whose source carries none
      --merge-into <MERGE_INTO>
          Force every record into one namespace
      --dry-run
          Parse and report without writing
      --no-dedup
          Skip exact and vector-cluster deduplication
      --min-length <MIN_CONTENT_LEN>
          Skip content shorter than this many bytes (0 disables) [default: 20]
      --min-importance <MIN_IMPORTANCE>
          Skip records below this importance (0 disables) [default: 0]
      --batch <BATCH>
          Records per batch (0 uses the backend default) [default: 0]
      --importance <IMPORTANCE>
          Default importance for records whose source carries none [default: 0.25]
      --confidence <CONFIDENCE>
          Durable confidence seed; negative uses the import default [default: -1]
      --dedup-similarity <DEDUP_SIMILARITY>
          Similarity threshold for the post-import dedup pass [default: 0.85]
      --extract
          Extract decisions, preferences, and problems from conversations
      --remote <REMOTE>
          Target a running memini server instead of the local store
      --token <TOKEN>
          Remote bearer token (defaults to MEMINI_API_KEY)
      --yes
          Skip merge-into confirmation
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `memini forget`

Bulk-delete memories by tag (for example, to undo an import)

```text
Bulk-delete memories by tag (for example, to undo an import)

Usage: forget [OPTIONS] --tag <TAG>

Options:
      --namespace <NAMESPACE>  Namespace to delete from (defaults to the resolved default)
      --tag <TAG>              Delete memories carrying this exact tag
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## `memini key`

Manage local API keys in this store's api_keys table

```text
Manage local API keys in this store's api_keys table

Usage: key <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add   Create an API key, or rotate an existing key's secret
  rm    Delete an API key
  ls    List API keys without secrets or hashes
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

## `memini key add`

Create an API key, or rotate an existing key's secret

```text
Create an API key, or rotate an existing key's secret

Usage: add [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>

Options:
      --home <HOME>
          Bind the key to a home namespace; an explicit empty value clears it
      --default-namespace <DEFAULT_NAMESPACE>
          Default namespace when a request supplies no namespace header
      --disabled [<DISABLED>]
          Set or clear the disabled state [possible values: true, false]
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `memini link`

Manage cross-namespace durable-tier read links

```text
Manage cross-namespace durable-tier read links

Usage: link <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add   Create or replace a read link from source to destination
  rm    Remove a read link
  ls    List links, optionally from one source namespace
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

## `memini link add`

Create or replace a read link from source to destination

```text
Create or replace a read link from source to destination

Usage: add [OPTIONS] <SOURCE> <DESTINATION>

Arguments:
  <SOURCE>
  <DESTINATION>

Options:
      --tiers <TIERS>  Comma-separated admitted tiers (default: durable tiers)
      --note <NOTE>    Free-text reason for the link [default: ""]
  -h, --help           Print help
```

## `memini namespace`

Inspect and repair memory namespaces

```text
Inspect and repair memory namespaces

Usage: namespace <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list   List namespaces and memory counts
  move   Move every memory from one namespace to another
  split  Regroup a pooled namespace into namespaces derived from metadata
  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```

## `memini namespace list`

List namespaces and memory counts

```text
Usage: list

  -h, --help  Print help
```

## `memini namespace move`

Move every memory from one namespace to another

```text
Move every memory from one namespace to another

Usage: move [OPTIONS] --from <FROM> --to <TO>

Options:
      --from <FROM>  Source namespace
      --to <TO>      Destination namespace
      --dry-run      Report what would move without writing
  -h, --help         Print help
```

## `memini namespace split`

Regroup a pooled namespace into namespaces derived from metadata

```text
Regroup a pooled namespace into namespaces derived from metadata

Usage: split [OPTIONS] --from <NAMESPACE>

Options:
      --from <NAMESPACE>  Namespace to split
      --by <BY>           Comma-separated metadata keys to group by [default: import_source_namespace,user_id,agent_id,run_id,project]
      --dry-run           Report the split without writing
  -h, --help              Print help
```

Re-embed memories with the configured embedding model

```text
Options:

  -h, --help                   Print help
```
